gist: Mason Crane is recalled to England's squad for the Pakistan tri-series.
Jofra Archer is rested while Jos Buttler is out injured.
Uncapped pair James Coles and Henry Crocombe are included.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Mason Crane has been recalled for England's upcoming one-day international tri-series in Pakistan. Sam Curran and Adil Rashid return from injuries, while uncapped players James Coles and Henry Crocombe join the squad. Jofra Archer is rested, and Jos Buttler misses out due to a hamstring injury.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The series forms part of England's white-ball schedule as they build up to the 50-over World Cup. Crane also has an opportunity to push his case to be England's number one spinner in Test cricket.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: England will play in the tri-series in Pakistan, which also involves Sri Lanka, ahead of further fixtures in Australia and South Africa.

fivew: England are building up to the 50-over World Cup and rotating their squad and coaching staff.
